purpose: Stage AI-Statistician evaluation from reproducible known results to open research while preserving task-specific evidence requirements and source leakage controls.

evidence_dimensions.meaning: Exact rerun of supplied immutable author code and data.
Definitions, assumptions, equation and claim lineage, counterchecks, and independent review.
Model-authored Python or R source executed and independently reviewed against current theory.
Frozen confirmatory protocol, fresh outcomes, and reported Monte Carlo uncertainty.
Exact target-bound Lean source, semantic review, and local kernel evidence.
Comparison against the frozen permitted source horizon.
Explicit evidence-bound defects and unclosed claims.

progressive_workflow.starts_when: external sources are permitted by task policy
pinned public code and data are supplied
the research question and source policy are frozen
estimand, DGP, consumed claim, and procedure interface are executable
independent review accepts the current theory and source semantics
metric contract, source review, cohort, and simulation precision rule are frozen
the theorem statement is stable or task scheduling is proof_first

allowed_pre_outcome_budget_rules: fixed resource budget with reported uncertainty

activation_evidence.public_reference: Benjamini and Hochberg, JRSS B 57(1):289-300, 1995, DOI 10.2307/2346101
activation_evidence.primary_failure_diagnosis: A substantive model-authored Markdown derivation was blocked because compact JSON claim and sanity-check anchors were required to occur literally in the document. This was a transport/index grammar defect, not proof that the mathematical derivation was complete.

The independent reviewer read the complete Markdown theory and task-bound sources but could not serialize its substantive audit into the old repeated per-claim and per-dimension JSON packet. Operator audit independently found false active algebra, an incomplete containment proof, a wrong confidence-quantile ABI, and other mathematical defects, so simplifying transport does not make the frozen theory correct.

activation_evidence.fresh_live_failure: After reading the workspace, the model made three document-authoring calls whose overloaded batch input had document_writes with the wrong shape. The same raw tool error returned to the model, and the existing no-progress guard stopped the repeated malformed call.
activation_evidence.capability_interpretation: The run establishes correct theory-only routing and fail-closed evidence behavior, but it does not judge mathematical competence because no model-authored document or theory packet reached independent evaluation.
activation_evidence.post_run_generic_harness_fix: Canonical TheoryDeveloper authoring now gives the same model one strict path-plus-content document tool and keeps structured JSON as a small claim index or executable ABI. No content repair, task rule, retry, tool-call budget, model tier, agent, or scheduler was added.
activation_evidence.post_run_direct_authoring_alignment: Initial and revision prompts now name the direct document, hash-bound edit, and structured-handoff tools exactly. The obsolete combined document_writes executor path and its scripted-test usage were deleted instead of retained as a fallback.
activation_evidence.post_run_long_horizon_progress: A model can now checkpoint substantive Markdown/LaTeX progress and continue the exact hash-bound workspace under the same TheoryDeveloper owner. Initial and reviewer-driven revision replays pass; partial state is not accepted evidence and no retry, budget increase, repair worker, Architect route, or task-specific rule was added.

activation_evidence.fresh_live_failure: The model used every authorized submission and left estimator_specs[0].id absent from the compact claim_index. With one final tool turn but no write submission remaining, it reported a theory gap instead of checkpointing the substantive document for same-owner continuation.
activation_evidence.fresh_live_document_audit: No capability credit: the unaccepted Markdown contains false intermediate noncentral-chi-square equations, circular dead ends retained as active derivation, and a key cross-term simplification asserted rather than derived despite stating the correct final risk formula.
activation_evidence.post_run_generic_checkpoint_guidance: TheoryDeveloper is told to checkpoint substantive progress when structured handoff work remains but write quota is exhausted, and authoritative documents must separate endorsed derivation from rejected exploration. No task content, automatic checkpoint, retry, budget increase, agent, or scheduler was added.
activation_evidence.post_run_claim_grounded_referee: The existing independent preflight now requires exact document reads covering every non-REJECTED claim-index anchor while the model still owns derivation, counterexample, and verdict semantics. Twenty-one accumulated corner-case prompt rules were replaced by seven general scientific-review principles. No reviewer, model call, tool turn, retry, budget, task formula, or runtime-authored judgment was added.

activation_evidence.fresh_live_scientific_diagnosis: The model-authored Markdown/LaTeX derivation coherently used orthogonal Gaussian decomposition, n-1 sample variance, independence, Student-t event inversion, exact normal-theory coverage, nonnormal scope, and the probability-zero S=0 boundary. Runtime and identity checks are not a hidden semantic verdict, so evaluator failure leaves theory unvalidated.
activation_evidence.fresh_live_reviewer_source_diagnosis: TheoryDeveloper read the task-bound 1908 snapshot, but the independent preflight had only compact runtime/formal-library retrieval and made three broad formal-library searches. Its ACCEPT therefore was not directly grounded in the permitted research-source snapshot.
activation_evidence.fresh_live_metric_diagnosis: The Architect expanded one requested empirical coverage target into five required gates and 4,880 runtime estimator calls. Although they passed, this was unnecessary confirmatory-portfolio expansion rather than evidence of better scientific design.
activation_evidence.post_run_hidden_semantic_fix: Calibration now requests only case-level labels while candidate adjudication retains per-claim statuses, and fail-closed evaluator exceptions persist a safe phase code without private validator text. The failed live task was not rerun or rescored.
activation_evidence.post_run_task_source_referee: The existing independent preflight now receives the same hash-bound search_research_sources/read_research_source tools as TheoryDeveloper. The model chooses every query and range; runtime returns exact text only to the active model and persists compact hash-bound refs. No agent, retry, tool-turn allowance, source router, task formula, or proof claim was added.
activation_evidence.post_run_metric_granularity_fix: Metric author and independent reviewer prompts now preserve upstream scientific-claim granularity and keep undeclared robustness or stress variants exploratory. No numeric gate count or task-specific metric rule was added.

activation_evidence.fresh_live_report_semantic_diagnosis: The Markdown report mislabeled the partially linear regression equations and residual score as the interactive regression model; the model read the paper PLR section but not the exact DoubleMLIRM definition in the supplied source snapshot.
activation_evidence.post_run_generic_harness_fix: source-only turn capacity now reaches the already-authorized tool-call capacity so the same model can correct a rejected terminal call; no tool-call or retry budget was increased
activation_evidence.post_run_source_grounding_fix: generic source search now returns the best non-overlapping result from distinct documents before filling remaining slots, and the existing TheoryDeveloper prompt requests the most specific primary definition or implementation for model-specific claims
activation_evidence.post_run_source_grounding_ablation: a representative query reconstructed from persisted matched terms returned five distinct top-5 documents and exposed the exact DoubleMLIRM implementation; the raw live query was not persisted, so this is not exact-query replay or live report-correctness evidence

activation_evidence.fresh_live_failure: The model wrote substantive Markdown/LaTeX and compact handoffs, then explicitly checkpointed unfinished anchor work. The same-owner continuation was rejected before a model call because the immutable initial authoring binding included the transient runtime task_id, while a valid continuation necessarily has a new task_id.
activation_evidence.fresh_live_document_audit: No capability credit: the unaccepted document expands the joint-covariance quadratic form incorrectly, treats symmetric two-by-two block structure as sufficient for arbitrary coordinatewise swap invariance, and gives an incomplete conditional-covariance PSD argument. These are model-authored mathematical defects, not transport errors, and must be found by model self-review plus independent semantic review rather than runtime content rules.
activation_evidence.post_run_shared_continuation_fix: Initial theory workspace identity now excludes only the transient scheduling task_id while retaining the exact question, prompt mode, Architect proposal, objective, tool contract, and other frozen context. The TheoryDeveloper prompt also asks the same model to recompute pivotal identities and test minimal and boundary cases before checkpointing. No task formula, content repair, retry, turn, submission, agent, scheduler, or model-tier change was added.
activation_evidence.post_run_nonformal_retrieval_fix: RetrievalMemory keeps paper and general knowledge scouting but makes zero Lean provider calls and persists no Lean topology when frozen task intent marks formalization not_applicable. Optional, required, and legacy formal retrieval remain available. No RAG corpus, model tool, research-source access, or Formalizer capability was removed.

activation_evidence.fresh_live_failure: The model authored a substantive Markdown derivation and a claim index, but the non-formal task contract also required duplicate theorem_cards and proof_plan handoffs. activation_evidence.post_run_document_native_handoff_fix: Non-formal theory now requires the authoritative Markdown/LaTeX claim DAG, estimator ABI when code is required, and simulation ABI when empirical work is required; theorem_cards and proof_plan are required only for a selected formal-authoring lane. Formal tasks retain their theorem, proof-plan, formalization-request, and kernel gates.
activation_evidence.post_run_lazy_lean_topology_fix: When every selected task declares formal=not_applicable, default Lean retrieval and proof-state providers are not instantiated and the manifest stores only a compact inactive descriptor. Optional, required, mixed, and legacy formal tasks retain the complete Statlib/Mathlib/StatInference provider path.

activation_evidence.operator_audit_chronology_error: Theory scratch output was labeled and used as frozen confirmatory evidence before independent metric authoring and downstream confirmatory execution.
activation_evidence.operator_audit_simulation_abi_error: Generated simulation ignored the runtime replicates argument and used a source-local count of 2000.
